items.title: StyleSmuggler: Unauthenticated Remote Code Execution (RCE) in Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source
items.summary: This critical zero-day vulnerability, dubbed StyleSmuggler, allows unauthenticated attackers to achieve remote code execution on affected Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source installations. Adobe is aware of active exploitation in the wild, with attacks confirmed from September 4, 2026.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source (CVE-2026-75650)
items.summary: Adobe released an emergency security update to address a critical vulnerability (CVE-2026-75650) that could lead to arbitrary code execution. This bulletin specifically addresses the StyleSmuggler zero-day which is being actively exploited.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source
items.summary: This regularly scheduled security update resolves critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities that could lead to arbitrary code execution, privilege escalation, and security feature bypass. Adobe is not aware of any exploits in the wild for the issues addressed in this bulletin, but advises applying the hotfix for CVE-2026-75650 in addition to this update.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source
items.summary: Adobe released a security update resolving critical and important vulnerabilities that could lead to arbitrary code execution, security feature bypass, and privilege escalation. These fixes were provided as isolated security patches.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source
items.summary: This security update addresses critical and important vulnerabilities that could result in security feature bypass, privilege escalation, and arbitrary code execution. Adobe was not aware of any exploits in the wild for these issues.

items.title: Unauthenticated PHP Object Injection in Mirasvit Cache Warmer for Magento
items.summary: Sansec discovered an unauthenticated PHP object injection flaw in the Mirasvit Cache Warmer extension, allowing remote code execution via a crafted cookie. The vulnerability is rated 9.8 (critical) and affects all versions before 1.11.12.
